title: MOBILE-INIT-001: React Native + Expo project scaffolding & monorepo integration
desc:
## Scope
Bootstrap the QicTrader mobile app inside the existing Qictrader monorepo. Stack: **Expo (managed workflow) + React Native + TypeScript**.

- Create `mobile/` directory at repo root alongside `frontend/` and `qictrader-backend-rs/`
- Initialise with `npx create-expo-app@latest --template tabs` (TypeScript)
- Lock Node + Bun versions in `.nvmrc` / `package.json` engines to match `frontend/`
- Decide on package manager: bun (parity with frontend) — confirm Expo CLI works with bun
- Add `mobile/.gitignore`, `mobile/README.md`, `mobile/DESIGN-PORT.md` (notes on how DESIGN.md applies)
- Wire monorepo scripts in root: `mobile:dev`, `mobile:ios`, `mobile:android`, `mobile:test`, `mobile:lint`
- Update root `commit-all.sh` to accept `--mobile-only` flag
- Document local dev prerequisites (Xcode, Android Studio, Watchman, JDK)

## Out of scope
- Any UI / screens (separate tickets)
- CI/CD (MOBILE-INIT-004)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `cd mobile && bun install && bun expo start` boots Metro
- [ ] `bun expo run:ios` launches in iOS simulator
- [ ] `bun expo run:android` launches in Android emulator
- [ ] TypeScript strict mode enabled (`strict: true`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true`)
- [ ] ESLint + Prettier configs aligned with `frontend/`
- [ ] Root README documents how to start mobile dev

## Dependencies
Blocks every other MOBILE-* ticket.

## Tech notes
- Prefer Expo managed workflow until we genuinely need bare RN (we likely won't — Expo supports native modules via config plugins)
- Use Expo SDK 52+ for React 19 / RN 0.76 New Architecture support
- Reference the engineering principles in `CLAUDE.md` — types first, no `any`, no swallowed errors

title: MOBILE-INIT-002: Port DESIGN.md system + UI library setup (NativeWind + tokens)
desc:
## Scope
Port the visual identity from `DESIGN.md` (the web frontend's source of truth) to React Native so the mobile app is visually consistent with web.

- Install **NativeWind v4** (Tailwind for React Native) — closest parity with the web frontend's Tailwind usage
- Mirror the design tokens from `frontend/src/app/globals.css` and `DESIGN.md`:
  - Brand blue `#00A3F6` → `--brand-blue`
  - Spacing scale, radius scale, shadow levels
  - Color palette (light + dark)
- Install **Poppins** font (weights 400/500/600/700) via `expo-google-fonts/poppins`
- Create `mobile/src/components/ui/` with primitive components: `Button`, `Input`, `Card`, `Text`, `Heading`, `Badge`
- Build a Storybook-equivalent (Expo Storybook or simple `/dev` screen) to showcase tokens + components
- Document the anti-patterns from `DESIGN.md` §11 in `mobile/DESIGN-PORT.md` and enforce via ESLint rule where possible (e.g. no hardcoded hex)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All design tokens exist as Tailwind theme entries in `tailwind.config.js`
- [ ] Poppins loads before first paint (use `expo-splash-screen` to hold splash until font ready)
- [ ] At least 6 UI primitives implemented and visually identical to web equivalents
- [ ] Dark mode toggleable via system preference + manual override
- [ ] No hardcoded hex values in components — only tokens

## Dependencies
Blocked by: MOBILE-INIT-001
Blocks: every UI ticket

title: MOBILE-INIT-003: Navigation, state management, API client
desc:
## Scope
Lay the architectural foundations that all features will lean on.

### Navigation
- Install **React Navigation v7** (`@react-navigation/native`, `native-stack`, `bottom-tabs`, `drawer`)
- Define top-level structure:
  - Auth stack (login, signup, verify, forgot-password) — shown when unauthenticated
  - Main tabs (Marketplace, Wallet, Trades, Profile)
  - Modal stack (Trade detail, Offer detail, Deposit, Withdraw, KYC)
- Type-safe navigation via `RootStackParamList` (strict TS types for every route + params)
- Deep linking config (scheme: `qictrader://`, universal links from `www.qictrader.com`)

### State management
- **Redux Toolkit** for global app state (user, auth status, currency preference) — mirrors frontend
- **Zustand** for ephemeral / UI state (sheets, modals, filters) — mirrors frontend
- **React Query (TanStack Query v5)** for server state + cache invalidation

### API client
- Axios instance with base URL from env
- Auth interceptor that:
  - Reads access token from `expo-secure-store`
  - Falls back to cookie storage via `@react-native-cookies/cookies` for cookie-auth parity with web
  - Auto-refreshes on 401 (mirror `frontend/src/lib/api-client.ts`)
- Request signing / CSRF header injection on mutating requests (parity with web)
- Error handling: typed `ApiError` discriminated union, no thrown strings

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Navigating between tabs preserves state; back gestures work on both iOS + Android
- [ ] Deep link `qictrader://trade/abc-123` opens the right screen
- [ ] React Query devtools accessible in dev builds
- [ ] API client typed end-to-end; backend response shapes mirrored as TS types
- [ ] 401 triggers refresh; if refresh fails, navigate to login + clear state

## Dependencies
Blocked by: MOBILE-INIT-001

title: MOBILE-INIT-004: Environment config + EAS Build CI/CD
desc:
## Scope
- Configure **EAS Build** (Expo Application Services) for managed cloud builds
- Set up build profiles in `eas.json`: `development`, `preview`, `staging`, `production`
- Environment variables per profile via EAS Secrets:
  - `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL` (dev → localhost, staging → qictrader-backend-staging, prod → qictrader-backend-rs)
  - `EXPO_PUBLIC_GA4_ID`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN` etc.
- GitHub Actions workflow `.github/workflows/mobile-ci.yml`:
  - On PR: typecheck + lint + test
  - On main push: trigger EAS preview build (internal distribution)
  - On tag `mobile-v*`: trigger EAS production build (store submission)
- Add `mobile/scripts/deploy-staging.sh` and `mobile/scripts/deploy-production.sh`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `eas build --profile preview --platform ios` produces an installable IPA
- [ ] `eas build --profile preview --platform android` produces an installable APK
- [ ] PR CI catches type errors, lint errors, and failing tests
- [ ] Production builds embed Sentry source maps automatically
- [ ] No secrets in repo — all via EAS Secrets / GitHub Actions secrets

title: MOBILE-INIT-005: Branding assets — app icons, splash screens, launch screens
desc:
## Scope
Produce all visual assets required by iOS + Android stores and Expo.

- App icon master (1024×1024 PNG, no transparency, no rounded corners — store rounds them)
- iOS icon set (all sizes generated via Expo asset script)
- Android adaptive icon (foreground + background layers)
- Splash screen (light + dark variants) using brand blue + Qic logo
- Notification icon (monochrome, 96×96 for Android)
- Marketing screenshots templates (will be filled in by MOBILE-LAUNCH-003)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] App icon renders crisp on iPad, iPhone, Android (all densities)
- [ ] Splash screen appears for ≤ 1.5s on app launch
- [ ] Adaptive icon looks correct in circular, squircle, rounded-square Android launchers
- [ ] All assets live in `mobile/assets/` and are committed to git (PNG, not binary blobs > 500KB each)

title: MOBILE-AUTH-001: Login screen + secure token storage
desc:
## Scope
- Login screen UI matching frontend: email + password fields, 'Show password' toggle, 'Forgot password?' link, 'Sign in' button, 'Sign Up' redirect
- Form validation (email format, password ≥ 1 char) via `react-hook-form` + `zod` (mirrors web)
- Submit calls `POST /api/v1/auth/login`
- On success:
  - Store `qic_access` JWT in `expo-secure-store` (Keychain on iOS, EncryptedSharedPreferences on Android)
  - Store `qic_refresh` separately (more restricted access)
  - Populate Redux `auth` slice
  - Navigate to Marketplace tab
- On 401: show inline error 'Invalid credentials'
- On 2FA required: navigate to MOBILE-AUTH-004 screen with `twoFactorToken`
- On network error: show toast 'Cannot connect to server'
- Loading state: disable inputs + button, show spinner

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Login with valid creds reaches Marketplace within 2s on Wi-Fi
- [ ] Token survives app cold restart (read from SecureStore on boot, validate, restore session)
- [ ] Biometric prompt offered after first successful login (defers to MOBILE-AUTH-005)
- [ ] No token written to AsyncStorage or unsafe storage
- [ ] Login attempt with bad creds shows error, never logs to console

## Dependencies
Blocked by: MOBILE-INIT-003 (navigation + API client)

title: MOBILE-AUTH-002: Signup + Terms acceptance flow
desc:
## Scope
- Signup screen: email, username (3-30 chars), password (≥ 12 chars), confirm password, accept legal checkbox
- Strength meter for password (mirror web — zxcvbn-based)
- POST `/api/v1/auth/signup` with `acceptedLegal: true`
- On success: route to `verify-email-pending` screen (next ticket)
- Honor backend validation errors (400) — display inline per field
- GA4 event `sign_up_attempt` and `sign_up_success`
- Honor referral code via deep link `qictrader://signup?ref=XXX`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All validation matches backend's `SignupRequest` validator exactly
- [ ] Legal documents (T&Cs, Privacy, Cookie) accessible from signup screen via in-app browser
- [ ] Referral code persisted across app restarts if signup not completed in one session
- [ ] Successful signup with referral records the affiliate link server-side

## Dependencies
Blocked by: MOBILE-AUTH-001

title: MOBILE-AUTH-003: Email verification + Forgot password / Reset password
desc:
## Scope
### Email verification
- `verify-email-pending` screen with 'Resend email' button (rate-limited UI)
- Deep link handler `qictrader://verify-email?token=XYZ` calls `POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email`
- On success: auto-login if backend returns tokens, else route to login

### Forgot password
- `forgot-password` screen: email input, 'Send reset link' button
- Calls `POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password`
- Always shows success message (no user enumeration)

### Reset password
- Deep link `qictrader://reset-password?token=XYZ` opens reset screen
- New password + confirm fields with strength meter
- Calls `POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password`
- On success: route to login with toast 'Password reset successful'

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Email links from backend (web URLs) gracefully open the mobile app via Universal Links / App Links
- [ ] Reset token expiry handled gracefully (show 'link expired' message)
- [ ] No password values logged or sent to analytics

## Dependencies
Blocked by: MOBILE-AUTH-001

title: MOBILE-AUTH-004: 2FA setup + verify
desc:
## Scope
### 2FA setup (from Profile > Security)
- Display QR code from `POST /api/v1/auth/2fa/setup` (TOTP secret)
- Manual key fallback (copyable)
- 6-digit code input + verify
- Display 8 backup codes (downloadable as text)

### 2FA verify on login
- After login, if backend returns `requires2fa: true`, navigate to verify screen
- Single 6-digit input (auto-advance, paste-friendly)
- 'Use backup code' fallback link
- Calls `POST /api/v1/auth/2fa/verify-login` with `twoFactorToken` + `code`
- On success: store tokens, route to Marketplace

### 2FA disable
- Requires current password + current TOTP code
- Calls `DELETE /api/v1/auth/2fa`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Backup codes are shown once only and warning issued before navigating away
- [ ] 2FA verify supports auto-fill from system TOTP managers (iOS Passwords, Authy, Google Auth) where possible
- [ ] Backend's exempt-list (SEC-CSRF-001) is honored — no CSRF errors on 2FA verify

## Dependencies
Blocked by: MOBILE-AUTH-001

title: MOBILE-AUTH-005: Biometric auth + session lifecycle
desc:
## Scope
### Biometric enrolment
- After first successful login, prompt 'Use Face ID / Touch ID / Fingerprint to sign in next time?'
- Store opt-in in SecureStore
- Use `expo-local-authentication`

### Biometric login
- On cold start, if user opted in: prompt biometric immediately
- On success: read access token from SecureStore, validate via `GET /api/v1/me`, restore session
- On failure or biometric not available: route to manual login screen

### Session lifecycle
- Periodic background `/me` check every 5 min to detect server-side session revocation
- Auto-refresh access token before expiry (silent, via React Query mutation)
- On refresh failure (401 from `/auth/refresh-token`): clear SecureStore + Redux, route to login

### Re-auth for sensitive actions
- Trigger biometric re-prompt before: withdraw, change password, disable 2FA, delete account

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No tokens leak to memory dumps (verify with `expo-secure-store` only)
- [ ] Session restoration on cold start < 1s if cached + valid
- [ ] Backgrounding app for > 5 min triggers re-auth on next foreground (configurable)
- [ ] Force-logout from web invalidates mobile session within 5 min

## Dependencies
Blocked by: MOBILE-AUTH-001

title: MOBILE-AUTH-006: OAuth — Apple Sign-In + Google Sign-In
desc:
## Scope
### Apple Sign-In (iOS + Android via web flow)
- `expo-apple-authentication` on iOS (required for App Store compliance if any other social auth is offered)
- POST identity token to `/api/v1/auth/oauth/apple` (backend already supports it)
- Honor `APPLE_SERVICES_ID` audience claim — verify backend SEC-SPRINT closeout

### Google Sign-In
- `@react-native-google-signin/google-signin` (iOS + Android native flow)
- POST ID token to `/api/v1/auth/oauth/google`
- Honor `GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` audience claim

### Common
- New user: backend creates account + returns tokens immediately
- Existing user: link OAuth identity to existing account (if email matches and verified)
- Conflict (email exists, not OAuth-linked): show 'Sign in with password to link Apple/Google to your account'

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Apple Sign-In button conforms to Apple HIG (height, color, label)
- [ ] Google Sign-In button conforms to Google brand guidelines
- [ ] OAuth signup auto-creates a verified email account (no extra verification step)
- [ ] iOS app cannot be submitted if Google Sign-In is offered without Apple Sign-In (Apple policy)

Blocked by: MOBILE-AUTH-001

title: MOBILE-KYC-002: Didit KYC flow integration (WebView)
desc:
## Scope
Didit is the current default KYC provider (per `architecture/DIDIT-MIGRATION-SPEC.md`).

- From KYC status screen, 'Start verification' opens a Didit session
- Backend creates session via `POST /api/v1/kyc/didit/session` and returns a URL
- Open URL in `WebView` (Didit's hosted flow — easier than native SDK for first ship)
- Listen for postMessage / URL navigation to detect completion
- On webhook delivery (`POST /webhooks/kyc/didit`), backend updates user → mobile picks up via push or polling
- Handle Didit return URL `qictrader://kyc/didit/return?status=completed`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Camera + microphone permissions requested in correct order
- [ ] WebView allows file uploads (iOS + Android)
- [ ] User can abort mid-flow and resume later
- [ ] Status updates from webhook reflect in app within 30s of completion

title: MOBILE-KYC-003: SumSub WebSDK fallback / legacy integration
desc:

SumSub is the legacy / fallback KYC provider (still wired in backend per `architecture/HEROKU-MIGRATION-SPEC.md`).

- For users assigned to SumSub provider (per `KYC_PROVIDER` env), use SumSub WebSDK in WebView
- Backend issues access token via `POST /api/v1/kyc/sumsub/access-token`
- Mobile renders SumSub iframe via WebView with token
- Handle webhook completion at `/webhooks/kyc/sumsub` (backend already enforces secret via SEC-SPRINT fail-closed)
- Same UX surface as Didit so users can't tell the difference

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] SumSub `SUMSUB_LEVEL_NAME` honored
- [ ] Live-selfie + ID document capture works on physical iPhone + Android device
- [ ] WebView console errors surfaced to Sentry

## Dependencies
Blocked by: MOBILE-KYC-001

title: MOBILE-KYC-004: Document camera capture + native photo upload helper
desc:
## Scope
Shared utility used by KYC, Proof-of-Payment (MOBILE-TRADE-004), dispute evidence (MOBILE-TRADE-006), avatar upload (MOBILE-PROFILE-002).

- `useDocumentCapture()` hook wrapping `expo-image-picker` + `expo-camera`
- Native camera UI with document outline overlay (rectangle frame for IDs)
- Auto-detect document edges + auto-crop (optional, can be deferred)
- Compress to ≤ 2 MB before upload (preserve EXIF only when not sensitive)
- Strip GPS / EXIF metadata before upload (privacy)
- Multi-photo support (e.g. ID front + back)
- Upload progress callback
- Retry on flaky network

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Camera permission rationale shown before system prompt
- [ ] iOS Info.plist + Android manifest entries correct
- [ ] EXIF GPS stripped before upload (verified with test image)
- [ ] Failed upload allows retry without re-capturing photo
- [ ] Works without flash; flash toggle available

desc:

title: MOBILE-LAUNCH-007: Production release runbook + on-call playbook
desc:
## Scope
- Document the end-to-end release process in `mobile/ops/release-runbook.md`:
  - Cut a release branch from `main`
  - Update version + build numbers
  - Tag `mobile-v{version}` → triggers EAS production build
  - Submit to App Store + Play Store via EAS Submit
  - Staged rollout on Play (10% / 25% / 100%)
  - Phased release on App Store (7-day Apple-managed phased release)
- On-call playbook for mobile incidents:
  - Crash spike: how to read Sentry, decide between hotfix + over-the-air update (EAS Update)
  - Cert pinning failure: rotation procedure
  - Backend incompatibility: emergency message in-app via Remote Config (deferred or simple maintenance flag)
- Hotfix path via EAS Update (for JS-only fixes that don't need a store review)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Runbook walked through by JP without referring to outside knowledge — succeeds end-to-end
- [ ] EAS Update can ship a JS fix in < 5 min without store review
- [ ] Rollback procedure documented for native + OTA paths
